# TL;DR: Alpha

`feature.fixture.alpha` · feature at `module.fixture` · about one minute.

## Purpose

Alpha coordinates two focused outcomes so the fixture exercises parent and child navigation.

## Functionality

Alpha is visible and registers the prepare and finish sub-features; it does nothing else.

## Structure

The core view is <a href="/architecture/fixture-alpha-components.html">Alpha Components</a>; it is embedded on this page.

```text
Alpha ──▶ Prepare Alpha ──▶ Finish Alpha
```

## Logic

1. Prepare the alpha inputs.
2. Produce the final alpha result.
